provider.description: Voice provider ID from bs-ai-voice.json (e.g. 'openrouter'). Uses the configured default when omitted.

model.description: STT model ID (e.g. 'openai/gpt-transcribe'). Uses the provider's default model when omitted.

file_path.description: Full path to the audio file to transcribe. Supports mp3, wav, flac, m4a, ogg, webm, aac (max 25 MB).

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'ja'). Omit for auto-detection.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 1. Lower values produce more deterministic results.
